Specification: This module specifies a Tendermint-style light client as a state machine that attempts to verify a target block height starting from a socially trusted header. It models both the light-client local state and an instantiated blockchain environment, including time progression, validator sets, fetched light blocks, verification status, and whether the primary full node is correct or faulty. The specification defines the verification logic, scheduling strategy, store updates, and a single-step system transition, and checks a collection of safety-style invariants and conditional correctness properties about successful verification, faulty primaries, trusting-period expiration, and probe complexity.
IfThenElse: IF ~ValidAndVerifiedPre(trusted, untrusted) THEN "INVALID" ELSE IF ~BC!InTrustingPeriod(untrusted.header) THEN "FAILED_TRUSTING_PERIOD" ELSE IF untrusted.header.height = trusted.header.height + 1 \/ SignedByOneThirdOfTrusted(trusted, untrusted) THEN "SUCCESS" ELSE "NOT_ENOUGH_TRUST"
IF height < ULTIMATE_HEIGHT THEN blockchain[height + 1].lastCommit ELSE blockchain[height].VS
IF IS_PRIMARY_CORRECT THEN CopyLightBlockFromChain(block, height) ELSE BC!IsLightBlockAllowedByDigitalSignatures(height, block)
IF h = ht THEN block ELSE lightBlocks[h]
IF h = ht THEN blockState ELSE statuses[h]

IF nextHeight \in DOMAIN fetchedLightBlocks THEN /\ current = fetchedLightBlocks[nextHeight] /\ UNCHANGED fetchedLightBlocks ELSE /\ FetchLightBlockInto(current, nextHeight) /\ fetchedLightBlocks' = LightStoreUpdateBlocks(fetchedLightBlocks, current)
CaseExpr: CASE verdict = "SUCCESS" -> /\ lightBlockStatus' = LightStoreUpdateStates(lightBlockStatus, nextHeight, "StateVerified") /\ latestVerified' = current /\ state' = IF latestVerified'.header.height < TARGET_HEIGHT THEN "working" ELSE "finishedSuccess" /\ \E newHeight \in HEIGHTS: /\ CanScheduleTo(newHeight, current, nextHeight, TARGET_HEIGHT) /\ nextHeight' = newHeight [] verdict = "NOT_ENOUGH_TRUST" -> /\ lightBlockStatus' = LightStoreUpdateStates(lightBlockStatus, nextHeight, "StateUnverified") /\ \E newHeight \in HEIGHTS: /\ CanScheduleTo(newHeight, latestVerified, nextHeight, TARGET_HEIGHT) /\ nextHeight' = newHeight /\ UNCHANGED <<latestVerified, state>> [] OTHER -> /\ lightBlockStatus' = LightStoreUpdateStates(lightBlockStatus, nextHeight, "StateFailed") /\ state' = "finishedFailure" /\ UNCHANGED <<latestVerified, nextHeight>>

[h \in DOMAIN statuses \union {ht} |-> IF h = ht THEN blockState ELSE statuses[h]]
